entries.summary: Assign logic type to outputs driven by always blocks.
entries.reasoning: Several failing designs (e.g., Prob026_alwaysblock1, Prob078_dualedge, Prob118_history_shift) assign outputs in always blocks but leave them as implicit wires, causing undriven or latch-related mismatches. This conditional rule targets exactly that pattern without affecting combinational assign-driven outputs.
entries.rule_text: If an output port is assigned inside an always block, declare it as logic (or reg) to avoid undriven/wire mismatches.

entries.summary: Flags output ports that have no assignment anywhere in the module.
entries.reasoning: Failures such as Prob016_m2014_q4j (sum[4] undriven), Prob078_dualedge (q undriven due to missing reg), and Prob118_history_shift (predict_history undriven) show a pattern of outputs never driven. A tool that detects undriven outputs will fire on these cases, prompting the debugger to add a default drive or proper reg declaration.

entries.summary: Allow one extra debugging iteration per problem.
entries.reasoning: Increasing max_debug_attempts from 2 to 3 gives the team an additional chance to apply fixes suggested by tools or rules, which has historically helped resolve stubborn mismatches without breaking already‑passing designs.
